config_locations: project .codex\config.toml (ignores model_provider, model_providers, openai_base_url, chatgpt_base_url, notify, profile, otel)
can_disable_login_prompt_note: With a custom provider and a command-backed token no ChatGPT sign-in screen or prompt appears.

telemetry_controls.effect: Stops plugin catalog and curated plugin sync (chatgpt.com, github.com), app and connector integration, in-app updates. Which single flag matters most is not established.
Disables anonymous usage and health data; also disables custom OTLP metrics exporters.
Rejects /feedback submissions (user-initiated). Documented, effect not confirmed.
Disables metrics export independently of logs and traces. Documented, effect not confirmed.
Log and trace export off unless configured.
Removes the web search tool; full-access sandbox defaults to live. Documented, effect not confirmed.
Disables one MCP server without removing its configuration.
Stops the update check; documentation advises false only when updates are centrally managed.
Restricts authentication method; whether it avoids chatgpt.com calls is not stated.
No connection outside the gateway was opened during a prompt.

auth.method: [model_providers.<id>.auth] command, args, timeout_ms, refresh_interval_ms; printed token sent as Authorization: Bearer
auth.notes: timeout_ms default 5000 must exceed helper time (15000 used). refresh_interval_ms default 300000; 0 refreshes only after an authentication retry. A 401 re-runs the helper and retries. Cannot be combined with env_key, experimental_bearer_token or requires_openai_auth. Provider id cannot be openai, ollama or lmstudio. Custom headers via http_headers and env_http_headers; query_params for api-version.

api_formats: openai-responses (POST <base_url>/responses, SSE); wire_api = responses is the only documented value
model_discovery_endpoint_behaviour: GET <base_url>/models?client_version=<v> several times at startup; expects {"models": [...]}. A {"data": [...]} list gives a non-fatal decode error and generic model metadata. Whether model_catalog_json suppresses the call is not documented.

config_snippets.content:
model = "<deployment-name>"
model_provider = "apim"
features = { plugins = false, remote_plugin = false, plugin_sharing = false, apps = false, in_app_updates = false }
analytics = { enabled = false }

[model_providers.apim]
name = "Azure APIM"
base_url = "https://<apim-host>/<openai-responses-api-path>"
wire_api = "responses"
# Only if the gateway needs them:
# query_params = { api-version = "<version>" }
# http_headers = { "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" = "<subscription-key>" }

[model_providers.apim.auth]
command = "powershell"
args = ["-NoProfile", "-File", 'C:\Users\<you>\bin\get-apim-token.ps1']
timeout_ms = 15000
refresh_interval_ms = 1800000

# Prints ONLY the raw JWT to stdout; on any problem prints a one-line reason to stderr and exits 1.
# Failing fast matters: both Claude Code and Codex retry hard on a bad token.
$Scope       = 'api://<apim-app-id>/.default'
$ExpectedAud = @('api://<apim-app-id>', '<apim-app-client-id>')   # accept both token forms
$MinLifeSecs = 60

$lines = & az account get-access-token --scope $Scope --query accessToken -o tsv 2>$null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: az failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE). Run: az login"); exit 1 }

# Tolerate banners/warnings on stdout: keep only the line that looks like a JWT.
$jwt = $lines | ForEach-Object { "$_".Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]+$' } | Select-Object -Last 1
if (-not $jwt) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('get-apim-token: az output contained no JWT'); exit 1 }

# Sanity-check the claims so a wrong audience or nearly-expired token fails here, not as an endless 401 loop.
$p = $jwt.Split('.')[1].Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/')
while ($p.Length % 4) { $p += '=' }
$claims = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($p)) | ConvertFrom-Json
$now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()
if ($ExpectedAud -notcontains $claims.aud) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token aud is '$($claims.aud)', expected '$($ExpectedAud -join "' or '")'"); exit 1 }
if ($claims.exp - $now -lt $MinLifeSecs) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token expires in $($claims.exp - $now)s"); exit 1 }

[Console]::Out.Write($jwt)

limits: Plugins, app and connector integrations and in-app updates are unavailable.
No environment variable or command-line flag is documented to disable analytics, updates, feedback or plugin sync; no single offline switch.
Model metadata for deployment names is generic when the /models shape differs.
Only the Responses wire format is supported for a custom provider.
Hosted tools (web search, MCP, apps) are not governed by the sandbox network settings.
verification_status: verified: command-backed authentication, refresh and failure behaviour, query_params and http_headers, network switch set. Optional extra keys (feedback, otel, web_search) not verified. Not verified against a production gateway.
